participants.label: Record store
participants.explanation: Steps, leases, evidence metadata, editions, amendments, audit and jobs. All SQL sits behind one repository module, so the v2 move to Postgres is a driver swap and one migration.

cards.title: The format is ours
items: There is no client SAT form to reconcile against
One standard format, versioned by us (A11)
A new project is a new step list, not a new layout

cards.title: Why versioning matters
items: A sealed edition must always render the same bytes
So a schema change after the first seal is a new form
